HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cake Making and Decoration? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cake Making and Decoration.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cake Making and Decoration.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cake Making and Decoration.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cake Making and Decoration.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Planning Family Meals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Meal Service and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Food Preservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cake Making and Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
